note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list, cross-checked against the Exophase and PSNProfiles listings. Every guide here is written for this page, in its own words, and names its source.

trophies.guide: Nothing extra to do here. It unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 are earned. Think of it as the receipt for finishing the list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Once the story is done, look under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion for the checklist. It covers story progress, stunts, challenges, vehicles, vaults and illegal operations. The parts that take longest are 300 stunts and 70 out of 80 challenges, so start on those early rather than leaving them for the end.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all feed this. The 100% list asks for 300, so 250 is only a stop on the way. Weave stunts into everyday driving and most of them will clear without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two shooting ranges share 42 challenges between them. Every one needs a gold medal, so learn how each range scores before you waste ammo on repeats. Clear a range in a single visit when you can.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission late in Chapter 4. Tail an armored van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner, the bags are too many for one person. The moment you step outside, expect four stars.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stranger missions turn up across the map as you play. Andy, Billy and Tyrone have trophies of their own, so their strands do not count here. Check the counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago appears in Chapter 3 and is time-sensitive, do it the moment it shows up.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Cards are scattered around Leonida in sets. Three full sets are the ask, not just three cards. Pick up every card you pass and the sets come together on their own.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game app for tagging spots. Open it at 100 different locations and the trophy pops. Tag places as you travel and you will pass 100 long before you start hunting for them.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida has nine activity types. Play one round of each and this pops. Trying each one is enough, you do not need to win.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Twenty different races, so repeats do not count. Street races and every other race type the map offers all feed it. Work through the race list and tick each new one off as you win it.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, build a four-star wanted level, then lose it. Bank vault jobs hand you four stars at once, so pair this with Maximum Withdrawal. It pops once you are clear of the red heat zone, not just out of the search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still on you. If the stars fade before the third shop, the chain breaks and you start over. It can take about half a minute to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan traffic with the WAiNK app as you drive and each new model counts as discovered. The 100% list wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100. City traffic fills the list fastest.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.guide: Drive every region until the map fills in. Coverage is the point, not speed, so take the long roads and the back corners. It will usually pop during normal play if you roam instead of fast-travelling everywhere.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations around Leonida. Rob one operation from each gang. The 100% list wants all 39 operations, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs. Sell them to your contacts to launder the money. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen drone race locations sit around the map. Win at least one race at each. Learn each course once, then run it clean.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: The total is cumulative across every shop type. Buy gear, clothes and ammo as you play and it adds up. If you are short near the end, vehicles and big-ticket items close the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Eight garages sell through the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story hands you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, pick Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register at Pay 'n' Spray with a standard tracker. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge. Out-fish him and the trophy is yours. Do it in Chapter 1 if you can, so it is banked early.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Four arcade games sit in the game world. Finish any one of them. Pick the one you are best at and run it to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia, it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Bring your partner to outdoor spots, each one should count twice if you meditate there with both characters. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim, L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline stretches Focus out, so pop some before you start.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use it on the back door, kicking the door in trips the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck, grab the cash and get clear of the heat. It pops once you are out of the red zone, not just out of sight. Save first, the police come fast.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Challenges live under Progress, then Challenges. Fifty of the eighty is the ask, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% list wants 70, so keep going past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission. Play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Nothing to plan, nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation, it feeds Positive Mental Attitude and never comes back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run, and the garage and Scooter Bros apps open here too.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears, it is time-sensitive. Jewelry store robberies open here with the Snap Gun.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. That's Where The Money Is opens bank vaults near the end of the chapter, so run it before you push on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it, there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the Breakfast Run mission. It also opens switching between Jason and Lucia, which most of the partner trophies need.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist mission to the end. It pops when the mission clears.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the Child's Play mission to the end. It pops when the mission clears.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the Headliners mission to the end. It pops when the mission clears.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the VCIA Takedown mission to the end. It pops when the mission clears.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the Operation Savage Glory mission to the end. It pops when the mission clears.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's questline through to its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's questline through to its final mission. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, it has its own trophy. The finale stays open after the credits.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's questline through to its final mission. It is Lucia-only. Her strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's questline through to its final mission. The finale stays open after the credits.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's questline through to its final mission. It is Jason-only. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count, gates E3 and E4 work. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport before it pops. Save first, the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description points at a military tank. Tanks sit on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables, the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. Leave something behind and the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, they train alongside you. The method is reported, not confirmed, so treat it as the best lead so far.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Five hundred actions that change your Criminal Profile is the reported count. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Play normally and check the counter now and then.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description is the only hint, a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Do not grind blindly for this one, wait for a confirmed trigger and check back.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description hints at a showroom escape, but nobody has pinned the trigger down. Do not grind blindly for this one, wait for a confirmed trigger and check back.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description hints at something failing once and working the second time. Do not grind blindly for this one, wait for a confirmed trigger and check back.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description hints at a strange event, but nobody has pinned the trigger down. Do not grind blindly for this one, wait for a confirmed trigger and check back.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description hints at a melee drive-by near the bowling alley. Do not grind blindly for this one, wait for a confirmed trigger and check back.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
